messages:
nina-cs: Starting NewShore dedicated bring-up. Need final quota, autoscale profile, loadtest slot. Renewal flagged — aim for clean SLO evidence.

sam-ops: Committed quota = 1,000 qps. Propose autoscale min=100 target=500 max=1000 step=100 cooldown=60s.

leo-eng: Plan: 2h shadow replay for cache warm, then 30m steady @500 qps, then two bursts to 800 and 1000 for 4m each. Prefer Fri 04:00 UTC.

maya-ml: We'll enable prefix KV cache + quantized variant gpt-small-q on pool-F. Expect ~10% qps reduction post-warmup.

ben-fin: Please include token-cost delta in the post-test report for renewal arguments.

nina-cs: Customer SLO: p95 < 240ms steady, no visible error spikes. Need rollback criteria to share with their SRE.

leo-eng: Rollback triggers: sustained error_rate >1% for 3m OR p95 >450ms for 4m. On trigger: abort bursts, route to hosted fallback, notify #oncall + cs@redwood.

sam-ops: I'll add tenant-protect throttle and a temporary ingress cap for the window. Pre-authorize fallback with oncall.

leo-eng: k6 commands (using shadow key, will redact):

``
k6 run --vus 500 --duration 30m steady.js --env TARGET=https://dedicated.newshore.redwood/v1/chat
k6 run --vus 800 --duration 4m burst1.js
k6 run --vus 1000 --duration 4m burst2.js
```

maya-ml: Dashboard panels to share: poolF_p95_latency, poolF_error_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate, fallback_count, scaling_events. I'll post permalinks.

nina-cs: Action items: Leo run test Fri 04:00 UTC; Sam apply autoscale + guardrails; Maya prep dashboards; Leo+Sam deliver post-test report next morning. I'll coordinate customer comms after steady phase.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: model-variant/gpt-small-q -> pool-F at 1765551500 :white_check_mark:

leo-eng: I'll post logs and grafana links here after run and redact keys.

nina-cs: Thanks team — be concise in the customer brief, focus on p95/p99, scaling events, and token-cost delta.
